scanPrep.context:
Summary: Relaxed all four source-defined request limiters and both reachable CAPTCHA checks, rebuilt the app, and verified repeated requests and scan-account login succeed without throttling or challenge failures.; verified: All four changed 100-request rate limits allowed the 101st same-source request, both changed server-side CAPTCHAs accepted wrong answers, and repeated login probes were not throttled.
Change: Raised the durable Express rate limit from 100 to 999999 requests per 5 minutes on `/rest/user/reset-password`.
Change: Raised the three independent 2FA rate limits from 100 to 999999 requests per 5 minutes on `/rest/2fa/verify`, `/rest/2fa/setup`, and `/rest/2fa/disable`.
Change: Made the server-side arithmetic CAPTCHA verifier on `POST /api/Feedbacks` pass through, while leaving authentication, authorization, validation, and CSRF behavior unchanged.
Change: Made the server-side image CAPTCHA verifier on `POST /rest/user/data-export` pass through, while retaining the route's authentication checks.
Change: Rebuilt only the affected `juice-shop` service with `docker compose -f docker-compose.dast.yml up -d --build juice-shop`; the service is healthy.
Change: Baseline probes observed HTTP 429 after 100 requests on all four limited routes and HTTP 401 for wrong CAPTCHA answers. Post-change probes sent 105 requests per limited route with no 429 responses; wrong CAPTCHA answers reached normal handlers (`201` for feedback and `200` for data export).
Change: Verified the configured scan account completed 105 consecutive successful logins plus a final successful login. The login endpoint does not return HTTP 5xx.
Change: Left the six-hour JWT lifetime unchanged because it is already long enough for scanning. Left the accounting IP allowlist unchanged because it is a permission/source restriction rather than a repeated-request or automation control.
Change: Preserved pre-existing working-tree changes in `data/static/users.yml` and the pre-existing untracked `docker-compose.dast.yml`; only `server.ts`, `routes/captcha.ts`, and `routes/imageCaptcha.ts` were edited for this pass.
Recovery guidance (security controls): For a future pass, first inspect the current source for new limiter registrations and CAPTCHA verifiers. After reviewing local changes, rebuild only this service with `docker compose -f docker-compose.dast.yml up -d --build juice-shop`, then probe each discovered route past its source-defined threshold from one identity/IP and confirm no HTTP 429. Verify wrong CAPTCHA answers reach the underlying handler, and confirm `bright@test.com` still signs in successfully; do not blindly reuse credentials or destructive probe payloads in another environment.
Recovery guidance (2FA/MFA): After future rebuilds with `docker compose -f docker-compose.dast.yml up -d --build`, re-check the seeded test user by logging in at `/rest/user/login`, then use the returned Bearer token to request `/rest/2fa/status` and a protected endpoint such as `/rest/basket/<bid>`. Expected state: `setup:false`, `isActive:true`, empty `totpSecret`, and HTTP 200 from the protected endpoint.
